- [RLOW.13.5] **Path access has two lowerings.** Known-schema
  paths resolve to a leaf-slot VAR node at compile time;
  `Json`-slot paths compile to `FN_JSON_PATH` calls
  ([RDSC.4a.9]); an unresolved path reads as `null` and a
  wrong-typed leaf raises a `TypeError` ([RLOW.6.3.4]). Restates [RLOW.6.3].
